strict_analysis.metric: Equal-Angstrom Euclidean polyline projection onto original 24 NEB path with extended endpoint tangents
strict_analysis.selection: Use exact selected_indices from each strict summary; burn first 5 ps once; block IDs are original production blocks 02-06.

projection_bins.interpretation: Raw frames, not independent/effective samples. The 15 peak-bin frames are from three windows; 14/15 occur in the first retained 5 ps block (block 02) and one in block 03.

extension_triage.decision_support: PI has authorized a uniform direct-US extension of all 63 windows from 30 ps to 60 ps on Violet. This triage is diagnostic, not a go/no-go: the rare s=0.4125 bin is contributed by three windows and strongly clustered in the first retained block, while the broader projected band spans eight windows. Track these windows in the 60 ps analysis and use the uniform extension to preserve cross-window MBAR support.
extension_triage.rationale: Prioritize peak-bearing windows 027/028/030; include windows with broader neighboring projected support for local bridge evidence. Consider CV-overlap neighbors once the existing overlap graph is consulted. Extend in 5 ps checkpoints and reassess temporal stability, overlap, and bin counts before committing further time.
extension_triage.all_63_to_60ps_cost: Six additional 5 ps production stages per window = 378 new stage executions. An 8-window +5 ps pilot is 8 stages; +30 ps is 48 stages. Extension cost is a planning count, not a runtime estimate.

continuation_mechanism.validated_prefix_behavior: Checks accepted stage receipts/checkpoint hashes and frozen-boundary/box gates, advances from the last accepted restart, and skips already accepted heating/equilibration stages.
continuation_mechanism.limit: production_limit is hard-limited to 1..6 and this campaign already has six accepted 5 ps production blocks in every window. Existing mechanism can resume an interrupted prefix without reheat, but does not extend completed 30 ps windows to blocks 7-12.
continuation_mechanism.extension_path: A separately versioned production-only continuation plan would need new block definitions rooted at accepted block-06 restart.ncrst, with the original topology, mask, bias restraints, integrator, and input hashes preserved; no such direct-US >6-block runner was verified in this bounded audit.

extension_triage.extension_plan_status: PI-authorized all-63-to-60-ps Violet extension; root is implementing 40 dynamic workers. No jobs were launched or altered in this audit.
extension_triage.runtime_caveat: Only two completed 5 ps block-02 process records were checked; durations varied substantially and are not a campaign-wide throughput estimate.

sampling_caveats: Sampling remains unconverged and no global barrier is accepted in the strict analysis.
The s=0.4125 raw count is temporally clustered and may represent only a few correlated episodes.
Near-peak projection support comes from noncontiguous umbrella window groups (026-030 and 035-037); confirm CV-space MBAR connectivity before a targeted plan.
No trajectories or native jobs were opened/launched; augmented CSV values and receipts only were read.
